observation.visible_scene: A wooden floor covered with an elaborate Domino-Rally style setup: a yellow circular hub with pink/red/yellow/green domino spokes at left, a green squiggle and a red bridge with green dominoes at top, a blue slide and a green/purple/yellow block pyramid at right, a yellow loop feeding a blue diagonal ramp at center-right, a row of white dominoes with a red/white ladder and a yellow remote-like device at right, and a long black domino chain snaking from the center down to a thick black block at the bottom, which then connects to a straight yellow domino line running to the blue ramp's base.
visible_changes: The black domino chain (both the thin snaking section and the thick block) is upright at the start and progressively topples during the excerpt, ending mostly lying flat by the later frames.
After the black chain collapses, the straight yellow domino line at the bottom begins to fall, with the toppling front advancing from the left end toward the right across the remaining frames.

The camera pans/tilts rightward and downward over the segment: the left yellow hub and the top blue slide/cabinet edge move out of view, while the white-domino row, the yellow remote device and the red/white ladder on the right enter the frame.
The green squiggle, the colored spokes, the yellow loop, the yellow dominoes on the blue diagonal ramp, the white-domino row and the block pyramid remain standing throughout the excerpt.
outside_clip_unknowns: What triggered the first domino of the black chain (the initiating contact is not shown).
Whether the falling yellow line continues on to topple the blue-ramp dominoes or other chains after the last frame.
The state of the setup before t=0 and after t=2.67s.
uncertain_details: Exact propagation direction within the thin snaking black section (a small loop appears to collapse early, but the front's origin is not clearly resolved).
Whether the framing change is pure pan/tilt or includes a slight zoom.
Minor motion-blur in some frames makes the precise position of the falling fronts hard to read.
